item.title: Shokushin 2
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Kairoudou
  • 発売日: 2009-03-27
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 触神2
  • 英語名: Shokushin 2

あらすじ

Demons consider exorcists their archenemies, and, above all, the most delectable prey. The spiritual energy emanating from their supple, youthful skin is a top-notch feast that’s hard to resist. Despite the danger, one can’t help but succumb to their own desires. Wielding lascivious tentacles, tonight, once again, the demons indulge in violating young girls brimming with spiritual energy.
